import pandas as pd

# Load both CSV files
ds = pd.read_csv('csv/driverStandings.csv')
races = pd.read_csv('csv/races.csv')

# Filter for Alex Yoong (driverId 62) with round < 20
yoong_races = ds.merge(races, on='raceId', how='inner')
yoong_filtered = yoong_races[(yoong_races['driverId'] == 62) & (yoong_races['round'] < 20)]

print(f"Found {len(yoong_filtered)} records for Alex Yoong with round < 20")
print("\nRace names:")
for idx, row in yoong_filtered.iterrows():
    print(f"  - {row['name']} (round {row['round']})")

# Get unique race names
unique_races = yoong_filtered['name'].unique()
print(f"\nUnique race names: {list(unique_races)}")
